mlk-day: The third Monday of January, honoring a civil rights leader
washingtons-birthday: The third Monday of February, honoring the first president
memorial-day: The last Monday of May, honoring the military dead
juneteenth: June 19, marking the end of slavery in Texas in 1865
labor-day: The first Monday of September, honoring workers
veterans-day: November 11, the anniversary of the end of World War I
thanksgiving: The fourth Thursday of November, with turkey
